name: Uploader and TXT Maker
description: Telegram uploader bot with a stateless authentication API

AUTH_USERS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to use the bot

AUTH_API_USERS.description: JSON array of Argon2id-protected API login accounts

JWT_SECRET.description: Random secret of at least 32 bytes

REFRESH_TOKEN_PEPPER.description: A different random secret of at least 32 bytes

ADMIN_USER_ID.description: Telegram user ID allowed to run /cookie

COOKIE_AUTH_IDENTIFIER.description: Login identifier for the cookie endpoint

COOKIE_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Login password for the cookie endpoint
